name: Eleanor's Lounge

evidence.note: Reviewers describe a bar with live music and a dance floor; one notes the dance area is small.
Event list shows weekly 'Karaoke and Dance Party' nights and Friday dance bands.
Copies of the bar's posts promote a country day where the band plays line dance hits, and bands that keep people dancing.
Venue site lists Miss Mayhem on Oct 3, 8-11 PM, $5 cover.

dancing.notes: Eleanor's has a dance floor, though reviewers say it is on the small side. Weekend bands and DJ dance parties get people dancing, and country band days feature line dance songs.

description: A long-running lounge on Sunrise Highway in Bohemia, popular with an over-40 crowd. It has live bands on weekends, karaoke, bingo and DJ dance nights.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Map listings show (631) 244-7090; the venue's own website shows 631-256-7443, which we used.
